notes: Measured on main be0b4abcd4083781de92a43667b5ee97b5ddc5a1 (grit 0.5.33) with `grit-bench daily` (single invocation of all 172 scenarios; 3 warmups, timed runs per tool, default per-scenario budget) on a 4-vCPU VM; grit is compared with git 2.43.0 only (no baseline release). The first invocation aborted during setup because grit-http-server was neither built nor on PATH (no report was produced and nothing was reused); grit-http-server was then built and the whole run restarted with it on PATH and --http-server set. The run started on 2026-11-09 (UTC) and the report is dated by the run's start day; the report's own timestamp is the time grit-bench wrote it. All 172 scenarios completed for both tools; no failures. The `repos` table is carried over from the previous report (same pinned fixtures, git.git v2.47.0) because grit-bench daily does not emit one. `area` keeps grit-bench's native area names (as in the previous reports) rather than remapping to the coarse list. Per-tool runs/samples_ms/min_ms/max_ms/stddev_ms and the whole detail object come straight from grit-bench; max_rss_kb is peak RSS bytes/1024. grit-bench also flags five extra rows as headline (branch/list-json, branch/merged, log/json-100, pull/rebase, push/force-with-lease); this report marks only the 17 scenarios from the headline table. The headline fetch/pull/push scenarios were measured by grit-bench against its own remotes as described in each scenario's detail. Noise check against the 2026-11-08 report: nine scenarios were re-run once more (--warmup 1 --min-runs 3, which gave 3-20 extra runs per tool depending on the per-scenario budget) and their samples pooled (median of all runs; max_rss_kb is the larger of the two peaks). Flagged for a time ratio >20% worse: branch/contains-json@git-git-10k-refs, branch/contains@git-git-10k-refs (both only because the tiny grit/git ratio ~0.001 moved; grit is ~1000x faster than git), clone/checkout@synth-100k, fsck/full@big-blobs, gc/default@synth-10k. Flagged for a memory ratio >30% worse: add/dry-run@synth-10k, commit/dry-run@synth-10k, stash/list@synth-10k, switch/large-blob@big-asset. No other scenario was re-run. Pooling confirmed add/dry-run (time 1.37x git, RSS 1.52x), commit/dry-run (RSS 1.43x) and stash/list (RSS 1.13x) as persistent memory regressions or near it; see the scenario rows for the pooled numbers.
